violations.detail: Plan promises "hypertrophy" but duration is 2wk — that adaptation is not physiologically deliverable in this window.

raw_text:
PLAN "Hotel Room Hypertrophy Maintenance - 2 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain hypertrophy gains while traveling"

PHASES
  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push and Pull":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_up 4x12..20 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          prone_Y 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          pigeon_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday rest
